title: Facilities Ops Log, 08:04: Dairy Lane Underwater, Lot C, Library

fields.logSource: Stage alarms (LT-MS-01, LT-DL-01) / Ops desk radio and phone entries

lines.msg: LT-MS-01 Mill Street culvert STAGE 7.31 ft. TREND RISING +1.7 ft/hr. FLOOD STAGE (7.0) alarm still active.
LT-MS-01 STAGE 7.60 ft. TREND RISING +1.7 ft/hr.
LT-MS-01 STAGE 7.88 ft. Approaching 8.0 ft threshold: DAIRY LANE CROSSING.
LT-MS-01 STAGE 8.24 ft. 8.0 EXCEEDED: DAIRY LANE CROSSING SUBMERGED. TREND RISING +1.7 ft/hr.
LT-DL-01 Dairy Lane crossing low point: WATER OVER ROADWAY. Status: CLOSED (CPD barricade, closure logged 07:02).
Next threshold 8.5 ft: Lot C fleet and mobile generators must be out (EOP Annex F 5.4). Projected at current rate: about 08:13.

RADIO, fleet coordinator, LOT-C: "Six trucks are out. Generator 1 is up the hill. Generator 2's trailer has a seized jack stand, so we can't drop it on the hitch. Water's at the hubs on the low row, and three trucks are left. I need a second tow vehicle in ten minutes or I'm leaving the generator."
Ops desk: tow request logged, awaiting AVP Facilities decision. Fleet crew still in Lot C: 4 staff.

PHONE, Whitcomb Library operations manager: "We've got the network distribution room and the bottom two shelf rows of Special Collections. My staff are in. Do we start carrying boxes now? IT says if we unplug the switches, the library and part of the campus Wi-Fi go down."
WL-WS-LL Whitcomb lower level water sensor: DRY. Library lower level floods at 12.0 ft. Latest forecast crest 10.8 ft (Ohio RFC 0720 AM).

instructorNote: This is a technical hurdle. Facilities should send a tow vehicle, set a cut-off by stage so crews leave Lot C near 8.5 ft even if Generator 2 is lost, start moving the Special Collections boxes now, and schedule the library network gear move well before 10.5 ft (2 h and 3 h move times). Check that Campus Police confirms the Dairy Lane barricade is staffed and the Marlowe Fire alternate route is still open, and that the IC logs the 8.0 crossing and checks the Riverside order against it.
